title: The frontend names the intra-trade health certificate "ITAHC" and carries a fourteenth document type, "Health certificate", that DR1 does not offer.

finding.frontend: Fourteen document types are defined, and the label the trader reads in the Document type column of the added-documents table is taken straight from that list (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/documents/view-model/rows.js:46-53). Two of the fourteen do not match DR1. ITAHC is labelled with the bare acronym, 'ITAHC', and there is an extra type, HEALTH_CERTIFICATE, labelled 'Health certificate' (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/documents/copy/copy.en.js:26-42); the enum behind both is fourteen codes long (src/server/app/services/document-types/stub.js:1-16). The captured row happens to be a veterinary health certificate, whose label matches DR1 exactly, so the divergence is not visible in this corpus's pictures.
finding.prototype: DR1's list is thirteen types and spells the certificate out in full — "Intra Trade Animal Health Certificate (ITAHC)" — both in the select and in the Document type column of the saved table (app/views/upload-documents.html:116-129, fed by designReleaseDocumentTypeOptions at app/routes.js:9015-9018). It has no "Health certificate" type; that option exists in the prototype only in a testing variant of the list that DR1's journey never selects.
finding.difference: Relabel ITAHC as "Intra Trade Animal Health Certificate (ITAHC)" and drop HEALTH_CERTIFICATE from the offered types, in both the English and Welsh copy files. The label change is visible today, wherever a derived ITAHC record is listed; dropping the extra type only becomes visible once the Document type select exists, so the two land together. Removing a code from the enum needs a check that no saved record already carries HEALTH_CERTIFICATE — nothing can produce one but a file named for it, and the derivation makes that possible today.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding the frontend rendering "Intra Trade Animal Health Certificate (ITAHC)" in the Document type column for a record whose derived type is ITAHC.
finding.verification: Counted both lists rather than trusting the count. The frontend's enum is fourteen codes (services/document-types/stub.js:1-16) and its labels fourteen entries (copy.en.js:26-42), including ITAHC: 'ITAHC' at :27 and HEALTH_CERTIFICATE: 'Health certificate' at :39; DR1's rendered select is thirteen options in both dr1-upload-documents and dr1-upload-documents-continue-error, opening "Intra Trade Animal Health Certificate (ITAHC)" and containing no "Health certificate". Ran the falsifier against the one captured row on fe-documents-populated: its Document type cell reads "Veterinary health certificate", which matches DR1, so the divergence really is invisible in this corpus's pictures, as the finding says. Traced the label to the cell at rows.js:49, `copy.types[entry.accompanyingDocumentType]`, inside the cited 46-53. Confirmed the testing-variant claim at routes.js:9020-9023, where testingDocumentTypeOptions prepends 'Health certificate' and is reached only through isTestingSessionData. CORRECT.
finding.correction: Mis-citation, fixed after re-verifying the claim. The prototype slot named designReleaseDocumentTypeOptions at app/routes.js:9019-9022, but that range is the blank line plus the opening of testingDocumentTypeOptions — the wrong list, and the very one the sentence is distinguishing DR1 from. designReleaseDocumentTypeOptions is at 9015-9018. The range has been corrected; the claim it supports was re-checked independently and stands.

relatedTo.why: the corrected list is what the new select must offer
